name: DKG MCP server (Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop)
description: Exposes the local DKG node as an MCP server so Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and other MCP-aware coding assistants can read from and write to DKG memory during a coding session. First-party integration maintained by OriginTrail.

security.notes: Only communicates with the local DKG node on 127.0.0.1:9200. Does not call PUBLISH (VM promotion) by default; Curator-authority operations are gated behind explicit user confirmation in the MCP client. No postinstall/preinstall scripts; the package is distributed under the OriginTrail npm organization with build provenance.

promotionPath: Session drafts land in Working Memory; the agent surface promotes selected assertions to Shared Memory for team visibility. Published Knowledge Assets anchored to Verified Memory become oracle-consumable inputs for downstream coding agents operating on the same project's context graph.
fitNotes: First-party reference integration. Demonstrates that OriginTrail-maintained packages can also live in the registry and be installed via `dkg integration install` — the registry is the unified distribution surface, not a second-class community channel. This entry is also a live example of the registry's update cadence: today it pins a pre-release dev build; when @origintrail-official/dkg-mcp ships a stable 0.1.0, the entry is bumped via a one-line registry PR. That's the intended maintenance rhythm for every entry.
